decision: Deletion of lap time (1:25.868) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Time 11:41 2019 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 October 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 8 did not use the track at the exit of turn 11, and was deemed to have gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Article 2c of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:25.868) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track during practice 1 and set a fast time. Penalty was applied according to 12.4. a) of the Race Directors Event Notes (version 2).
rules_referenced: Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 8 Track Limits Deletion Of Lap Time
